purpose: Prioritize falsifiable hypothesis research and define next data, replay, independent holdout and paper-reconciliation gates without approving an instrument, contract, allocation, holding or action.

decision_boundary.candidate_definition: A candidate is a hypothesis and test sequence only, never a security, product, contract, allocation or action.
decision_boundary.continue_definition: May proceed only to data-contract, rule-freeze and audit preparation; it does not authorize performance iteration or admission.
decision_boundary.pause_definition: No result-driven parameter search or replay is permitted until stated prerequisites are accepted.
decision_boundary.retire_definition: Ends the named exploratory test definition only; it does not remove an asset class from U0 or reject a broader economic hypothesis.
decision_boundary.no_action: No current product, contract, allocation, holding, order, execution instruction or return conclusion exists.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: Defines H1, H2 and H3 as unfrozen, unreplayed and unusable hypotheses with existing field and falsifier requirements.
evidence_basis.non_inference: Does not establish performance, eligibility or personal execution.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: Keeps ten domestic listed security and derivative classes in the open research population.
evidence_basis.non_inference: Does not admit any class or item into T2.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: Venue rules, personal entitlement, execution and replay readiness are separate questions for all ten U0 classes.
evidence_basis.non_inference: Venue rules do not prove a person's account permission, broker route, fee terms or fillability.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: Across the reported 0-, 10-, 20- and 50-bps sensitivities, all seven H01--H07 variants in the four-ETF public-price exploratory sample have at least one rolling five-year arithmetic endpoint below 0.05.
evidence_basis.non_inference: The limited public-price sample is not U0, T2, a total-return ledger, an execution result or a test of H3.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: The repaired public-series screen passed independent review of its disclosed monthly self-financing accounting, annual carry-forward arithmetic and case-local sealed-source controls.
evidence_basis.non_inference: That narrow accounting/integrity pass does not validate historical source timing, total return, execution or strategy eligibility.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: Fifteen retained SSE samples identify selected H1 disclosure/action/status and H3 REIT, ETF and convertible field routes for the next source inquiry.
evidence_basis.non_inference: Selected current or retrospectively retrieved fields do not establish complete point-in-time inputs, total return, execution or strategy eligibility.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: Official H1 procurement, disclosure and authorization routes are identified, including a Shanghai historical-data subscription route, but no accepted delivery or written right exists in the case.
evidence_basis.non_inference: A public or uncontracted route does not establish complete SH/SZ/BJ coverage, point-in-time financials/events, replay rights or H1 eligibility.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: Official H3 market-data, fixed-income and rights-inquiry routes are identified, but no accepted dual-venue delivery, event/terms package or written right exists in the case.
evidence_basis.non_inference: A service, price or display-authorization page does not establish point-in-time total-return inputs, execution evidence or H3 eligibility.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: A research-only forward-intake and later formal-paper-observation control sequence is defined.
evidence_basis.non_inference: A design or future intake record does not establish an accepted input, a replay, a recommendation or strategy eligibility.

evidence_basis.usable_fact: Defines frozen replay, endpoint, ledger, holdout and prospective-coverage hard controls.
evidence_basis.non_inference: Requirements alone are not a runnable or passing replay.

strict_historical_hurdle.scope: A future, predeclared combined rulebook only; never an isolated module label or a future-return assertion.
strict_historical_hurdle.complete_calendar_year_rule: Every complete calendar year's net TWRR must be greater than or equal to 0.05.
strict_historical_hurdle.rolling_five_year_rule: Every eligible rolling five-year endpoint's annualized net TWRR must be greater than or equal to 0.05.
strict_historical_hurdle.required_endpoint_state: FAIL, INCOMPLETE and INVALID endpoint counts must each equal zero.
required_accounting: Use unit NAV or an equivalent chain-linked unit NAV rather than a total-NAV ratio when external flows exist.
Retain all verified costs, taxes, spreads, impact, no-fill, settlement, corporate-action, margin and collateral effects.
Retain every failure endpoint and data revision.
strict_historical_hurdle.non_inference: Passing a historical test would not guarantee, forecast, establish a floor for or assign a probability to future returns.

research_queue.title: A-share quality-trend cross-sectional research
research_queue.rationale: Official samples and route archives identify report-index, distribution, capitalization, suspension and future procurement routes, but point-in-time fundamentals, full status history, complete corporate actions, written rights, costs and executable-state evidence are not accepted.
research_queue.next_allowed_output: A population-status-fundamental-availability-execution-cost data contract and gap audit, with no security names or performance result.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: Every ranking input used for every included or excluded security has a source, raw hash, revision and available_at not later than decision_at; critical missing count equals 0.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: Affected month is INCOMPLETE or INVALID; it cannot be repaired by silent removal.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: A rebalance with fewer than 20 qualified securities is LOW_COVERAGE and cannot be cured by relaxing the threshold.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: A primary-holdout occurrence without a pre-frozen LOW_COVERAGE disposition makes affected endpoints ineligible.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: Lot, T+1, limit, halt, cost, fill/no-fill and settlement states are present for every generated transaction path; unresolved count equals 0.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: No H1 performance result may be reported.

research_queue.title: REIT, bond/convertible-bond and listed-fund valuation-trend research
research_queue.rationale: Official samples and route archives identify selected REIT NAV/distribution, ETF PCF/snapshot, convertible terms/event and future service routes, but the four-ETF public-price sample, service pages and local fields cannot represent the full product population, event ledger or execution accounting.
research_queue.next_allowed_output: A category master, market-price/NAV/event reconciliation design, bond-term and REIT-operating-field data acceptance plan, with no security selection or result.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: For each applicable product or bond, unexplained market-price, NAV/accumulated-NAV, distribution/coupon, redemption, conversion, maturity, issuance-expansion, credit or status-event differences equal 0 after the pre-frozen reconciliation rule.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: Affected item or class is not replayable; a close price or static yield cannot substitute.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: Every valuation, term, underlying-operating and credit input has version and available_at no later than its decision timestamp; critical missing count equals 0.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: Affected endpoint is INCOMPLETE or INVALID.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: Trading, redemption, halt, lot, settlement, fee, tax and route terms are resolved for every generated path; unresolved count equals 0.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: No H3 result may be promoted beyond data preparation.

research_queue.title: Domestic commodity and financial futures actual-contract trend research
research_queue.rationale: Actual-contract selection, roll, daily margining, delivery, price limits and session controls cannot be reconstructed from the current limited retrospective probes.
research_queue.next_allowed_output: A data-availability and rule-version proof for actual-contract lifecycle, settlement, margin, limit, delivery and session records; no trend result.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: Each selected contract is an actual listed contract and has days to last trade or delivery greater than or equal to max(15 trading days, the then-effective delivery buffer).
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: That product has no eligible observation; an old, continuous or ex-post lead contract cannot replace it.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: Settlement, multiplier, margin, limit, position limit, fee, session, roll and delivery fields have critical missing count equal to 0 for each selected-contract day.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: Affected day or endpoint is INCOMPLETE or INVALID.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: No unresolved or failed state exists for a generated execution, margin, forced-risk, settlement or delivery path.

research_queue.title: Listed-option independent extension
research_queue.rationale: H2 does not depend on options, and option permission, margin, exercise, assignment, volatility and settlement facts are not accepted.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: Independent hypothesis, contract master, entitlement, margin, exercise/assignment and settlement ledgers are all accepted before any replay design.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: Remain paused; do not borrow H2 inputs or results.

research_queue.title: Leveraged and inverse listed-product independent route
research_queue.rationale: The class has no accepted unified population, daily-reset terms or broker-support facts and cannot be inferred from its name.
research_queue.next_allowed_output: A class-master and term-fact checklist only.

module_falsification_thresholds.threshold: Class master, daily-reset/risk terms, event history, entitlement and execution-state fields are accepted before an independent hypothesis is proposed.
module_falsification_thresholds.failure_effect: Remain outside H1-H3 replay design while remaining in U0.

retired_exploratory_family.scope: Four-ETF public-price exploratory observation only, not an asset universe or a product list.
retired_exploratory_family.observed_stop_signal: Across the reported 0-, 10-, 20- and 50-bps public-price sensitivities, every H01-H07 variant has at least one rolling five-year arithmetic endpoint below 0.05.
retired_exploratory_family.independent_audit_status: PASS for the disclosed research-only monthly self-financing accounting and case-local source-integrity controls; it remains non-PIT, non-total-return and non-execution evidence.
prohibited_follow_up: Do not search for a survivor by changing lookback, risk budget, breadth, cost sensitivity or date window in the same sample.
Do not cite the current arithmetic output as an investor total return, formal replay or H3 verdict.
reconsideration_preconditions: A newly accepted, written-rights, point-in-time and event-complete data package.
A different rulebook frozen before its results are visible.
Independent review and the complete formal replay protocol.

u0_coverage.route: H3; public H01-H07 family retired in its current definition

shared_hard_gates.threshold: Written rights cover retention, normalization, replay, derivative analysis and independent review; critical-field, rights and source-version unresolved counts each equal 0.
shared_hard_gates.failure_effect: INVALID; public pages, downloads or interface documentation cannot substitute.

shared_hard_gates.threshold: Every decision input has available_at not later than decision_at; expected population equals actual unique population; count_residual and silent-exclusion counts each equal 0.
Prospective coverage has zero UNRESOLVED, FAILED, non-PASS and missing expected tuples; any FAILED settlement exists in zero rows.
Input hashes, frozen rules, environment, unit NAV, fees, taxes, events, positions and residuals reconcile exactly; unexplained discrepancy count equals 0.
For a predeclared combined rulebook, every complete calendar year and eligible rolling five-year endpoint meets the 0.05 net-TWRR threshold, with zero FAIL, INCOMPLETE and INVALID endpoints.
shared_hard_gates.failure_effect: The frozen rulebook fails the strict historical research hurdle.

shared_hard_gates.threshold: PRIMARY_HOLDOUT actual endpoint count equals frozen expected count and is at least 126; every endpoint is PASS; CROSSING does not substitute.
For each U0 parent class ultimately sent to paper testing, at least 60 calendar days and 10 distinct eligible observations are recorded, with zero unresolved state, cost or reconciliation exception.
shared_hard_gates.failure_effect: Incomplete or failed paper reconciliation; q remains 0.

stages.name: data_acceptance
pre_result_requirements: Written rights and immutable delivery manifest.
U0 population, point-in-time availability and execution/entitlement facts accepted.
stages.stop_rule: Any critical package failure stops before replay.

stages.name: freeze_before_results
pre_result_requirements: Freeze U0-to-T2 derivation, parameters, development and primary-holdout windows, calendar, execution/cost/settlement model, risk package and endpoint roster.
Bind source, code, environment and commands to one run record.
stages.stop_rule: A post-result change requires a new run identifier and cannot overwrite the locked run.

stages.name: development
pre_result_requirements: Use only the designated development partition for implementation and predeclared fault diagnosis.
Retain every candidate, failure endpoint and exclusion reason.
stages.stop_rule: Development output cannot reset primary-holdout parameters.

stages.name: primary_holdout
pre_result_requirements: Re-run from a lockbox start state using the frozen roster and complete daily ledger.
Reconcile expected and actual endpoint populations.
stages.stop_rule: Any count shortfall, contamination, FAIL, INCOMPLETE or INVALID endpoint is an out-of-sample failure.

stages.name: independent_review
pre_result_requirements: A reviewer separate from the model author recomputes hashes, endpoints, TWRR, events, costs and residuals in an isolated working directory.
Record whether the source copy is independently sourced or only reproducibly archived.
stages.stop_rule: Any unexplained difference is a failure; a shared source copy may not be described as independent source validation.

stages.name: prospective_paper_reconciliation
pre_result_requirements: Begin after freeze and record observation time, quote/depth, simulated submission, fill/no-fill, fees, taxes, settlement, margin/collateral, events and risk state without transmitting a live instruction.
Meet G7 duration, observation and reconciliation requirements.
stages.stop_rule: Any unresolved exception leaves the design unusable and q at 0.

next_test_design.independence_boundary: Model author, data acceptance/review and endpoint reproduction must be segregated. A repeated calculation on the same mutable public source is neither an independent sample nor an independent data validation.

public_source_non_substitution: Four public ETF price series are not a point-in-time, class-neutral U0 population or a T2 derivation audit.
Retrospective retrieval without available_at, revision chain and written rights cannot establish historical availability or permitted replay use.
Unverified adjusted closing prices without a market-price/NAV/IOPV/distribution/corporate-action chain cannot establish total return or unitization.
The sources do not provide a full trading-state, calendar, price-limit, T+1, depth, fill/no-fill, fee, tax, settlement, margin or personal-route ledger.

The current public-screen model's disclosed self-financing, complete-year and case-local source controls passed independent re-audit, but the public inputs remain non-PIT, non-total-return and non-execution evidence.
A second public price path with close arithmetic results is path corroboration only, not independent source, model or execution validation.

continue: H1 data and rule preparation at P1.
H3 category-neutral event and total-return data preparation at P2.
pause: H2 actual-contract research at P3 pending feasibility evidence.
Listed-options extension and leveraged/inverse independent route at P0.
current_conclusion.retire: H01-H07 four-ETF public-price exploratory family in its current definition.
current_conclusion.open_universe: All ten U0 classes remain in the research population; no class is admitted into T2 by this artifact.
current_conclusion.strategy_status: No formal replay, independent sample-out result, paper reconciliation, product, contract, allocation, holding, action or return conclusion exists; portfolio_q remains 0.
